title: Terms of service
translation_note: This translation is for your convenience. If it differs from the English version, the English version prevails.
intro: By using Vendora, you agree to these terms. If you don't, please don't use the platform. We may update these terms; meaningful changes will be announced via email and a banner notice 30 days before they take effect.

eligibility.title: 1. Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be at least 18 years old and able to enter a binding contract in your jurisdiction. Vendors must be a legitimate business — sole proprietors, LLCs, corporations.

account.title: 2. Your account
account.body: You're responsible for keeping your password safe and for any activity under your account. Tell us immediately at <email>hello@eventvendora.com</email> if you suspect unauthorized access.

hosts.title: 3. For hosts
hosts.body: Browsing Vendora and sending inquiries is free for hosts. When you book a vendor, you contract directly with that vendor — Vendora is the introduction layer, not the contracting party. Payment terms, cancellation policies, and deliverables are between you and the vendor.

vendors.title: 4. For vendors
vendors.commission: Vendora charges 3% on confirmed bookings ("won" inquiries). No listing fees, no monthly minimums.
vendors.membership: Membership is month-to-month; you can pause or leave any time without penalty.
vendors.your_data: Vendor profiles, portfolios, and reviews are your data. You can export your reviews at any time, including if you leave the platform.
vendors.ranking: We do not accept money to influence search ranking. Sort order is determined by fit and quality signals only.
vendors.delivery: You're responsible for delivering the services you describe in your profile and quotes.

conduct.title: 5. Prohibited conduct
conduct.body: You agree not to: scrape vendor data, attempt to circumvent Vendora's commission by transacting off-platform after an introduction, post false or misleading reviews, harass other users, or use the platform for anything illegal.

content.title: 6. Content + intellectual property
content.body: You retain ownership of everything you upload (portfolio images, messages, reviews). By posting, you grant Vendora a worldwide, royalty-free license to display it within the platform and (for vendors) in editorial features that promote your business.

ai.title: 7. AI-assisted replies
ai.body: When the AI inquiry agent is active, vendors review and approve every drafted reply before it sends. Vendora is not responsible for the content of vendor messages, AI-drafted or otherwise.

disclaimers.title: 8. Disclaimers
disclaimers.body: Vendora is provided "as is." We don't guarantee any specific vendor's availability, quality, or performance — vendors are independent businesses. Reviews are user-submitted opinion.

liability.title: 9. Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Vendora's liability is limited to fees you've paid us in the 12 months prior to a claim. We're not liable for indirect, consequential, or punitive damages.

termination.title: 10. Termination
termination.body: You can close your account anytime from your settings. We can suspend accounts that violate these terms with notice (or without notice for severe violations).

law.title: 11. Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. Disputes are resolved in courts located in New York County.
